PAYDAR / PRIVACY

Privacy by design.

Android application

The beta stores checks, imported records, subscription entries, transaction receipts and recovery drafts in the app's private local database. Optional Google sign-in uses Firebase Authentication; Google and Firebase process account identifiers, name, email and authentication information. Payment records are not uploaded or synced.

PayDar does not request SMS access, notification permission or notification-listener access. Your inbox and notifications remain outside the app. Share a receipt from your payment app, paste its text, import a CSV or add a record manually.

Camera access is used only to decode a QR code after you start a scan. Sharing a recovery draft or opening an official support page is an action you start; the receiving app or site then handles that information under its own policy.

Accounts and deletion

Delete your Firebase account from the Account screen after confirming your Google identity. Local records are deleted separately using Delete local PayDar data. Signing out does not erase this device's records, and accounts do not create separate local ledgers.

Marketing website

This website is a hosted product presentation. Its browser demonstration uses information entered on the current page only and does not initiate a payment. No advertising or analytics SDK is included.

Questions

Before production release, publish a named data controller, support contact, retention schedule and store-ready privacy policy matching the final permissions and integrations.
